description: Headline figures from the published monthly Cayman Hiring Report (job adverts posted on the official WORC Jobs Portal that month: adverts, positions, employers, median advertised pay, most advertised sectors, best-paid sectors, advert length), exactly as published, with a link to the full report and its method. These are counts of public adverts by Cayman Job Finder, not official WORC statistics. Defaults to the latest edition.

edition.description: Report month as YYYY-MM (published: 2026-10). Default: the latest.

name: hiring_report_stats
title: Cayman Hiring Report figures
